item.title: Evolution Or Production?
item.description: By Jnana Dasa Implicit in current theories of evolution are two basic assumptions: first, that the myriad living forms have come into being exclusively by chance and the action of natural laws; and second, that consciousness and all life processes are nothing more than physiochemical interactions. item.title: Why does our consciousness change suddenly from devotional to sensual?
